titulo: Ele fugiu de Deus. No fundo do mar, Deus ainda ouviu
estilo_imagem: cinematic photorealistic epic film still, dramatic volumetric god rays, floating dust particles, deep chiaroscuro, ancient Near East and the Mediterranean Sea in the Iron Age, muted earthy tones, vertical 9:16
prefixo_video: Cinematic epic film shot, slow and subtle motion.
epoca_imagem: Iron Age Mediterranean, eighth century BC, the ancient port of Joppa, Phoenician wooden sailing ships, Assyrian Nineveh with massive mud-brick walls, stone, clay, wood, rope and cloth only, nothing modern

cenas.trecho: Ele fugiu de Deus e foi parar no fundo do mar. Seu nome era Jonas.
cenas.prompt_imagem: deep underwater view in the dark sea, faint god rays falling from the stormy surface far above, the immense dark shadow of a great fish gliding through the deep blue
cenas.prompt_movimento: the light rays waver slowly, particles drift in the water, the great shadow glides forward, slow camera descent

cenas.trecho: Deus o mandou a Nínive, capital da Assíria, o império inimigo de Israel.
cenas.prompt_imagem: epic high aerial view of the ancient Assyrian city of Nineveh by the Tigris river, massive mud-brick walls and monumental gates, palace terraces, golden dusty haze
cenas.prompt_movimento: slow aerial camera glide toward the city walls, haze drifts, the river glimmers

cenas.trecho: Jonas desceu a Jope e embarcou num navio para Társis, na direção oposta.
cenas.prompt_imagem: high-angle view of the ancient stone harbor of Joppa at sunset, wooden Phoenician sailing ships moored at the quay, clay amphorae stacked on the stones, the open sea beyond
cenas.prompt_movimento: sails move gently in the breeze, the water ripples, sunset light glows, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Veio uma grande tempestade. Os marinheiros, a pedido dele, o lançaram ao mar.
cenas.prompt_imagem: wide view of a small ancient wooden sailing ship tossed by huge dark waves in a violent storm at night, torn sail, lightning in the clouds
cenas.prompt_movimento: huge waves rise and crash, the torn sail whips in the wind, lightning flashes, slow camera pull-back

cenas.trecho: E o mar se acalmou. Mas Deus fez um grande peixe engolir Jonas.
cenas.prompt_imagem: a calm silver sea at dawn after the storm, a lone wooden ship far away on the horizon, soft rays of light breaking through the clouds onto the still water
cenas.prompt_movimento: the still water shimmers, light rays spread slowly through the clouds, slow camera rise

cenas.trecho: Três dias e três noites no ventre do peixe, no escuro do mar.
cenas.prompt_imagem: deep dark ocean abyss, a single faint beam of light from far above, the vast shadow of a great fish against the deep blue, drifting seaweed
cenas.prompt_movimento: the faint beam wavers, seaweed drifts slowly, the shadow moves softly, slow camera push-in

cenas.trecho: Ali ele orou: Em meu desespero clamei ao Senhor, e ele me respondeu.
cenas.prompt_imagem: underwater view looking up from the deep toward the distant bright surface, columns of golden light piercing the dark water, tiny rising bubbles
cenas.prompt_movimento: bubbles rise slowly toward the light, the light columns shimmer, slow camera rise

cenas.trecho: Quando a minha vida já se apagava, eu me lembrei de ti, Senhor.
cenas.prompt_imagem: long strands of seaweed swaying in the dark deep sea, a brightening ray of light reaching down from far above through the water
cenas.prompt_movimento: the seaweed sways gently, the ray of light grows brighter, slow camera push-in toward the light

cenas.trecho: Então o Senhor deu ordens ao peixe, e ele vomitou Jonas em terra firme. Jonas, capítulo dois.
cenas.prompt_imagem: an empty sandy beach at sunrise, gentle foamy waves washing ashore, footprints in the wet sand leading inland toward desert hills, golden light
cenas.prompt_movimento: waves wash slowly over the sand, golden light spreads across the beach, slow camera glide along the footprints

cenas.trecho: Se você fugiu e afundou, clame de onde está. Deus ainda ouve do fundo do mar.
cenas.prompt_imagem: underwater view from the deep sea looking up at a bright golden sunrise above the surface, god rays streaming down through the clear water
cenas.prompt_movimento: the god rays shimmer and grow brighter, particles float upward, slow camera rise toward the surface

legenda:
Senhor, mesmo no fundo, eu clamo a ti 🙏🌊
Jonas 1:1–2:10
Comente "Amém" se Deus já te tirou do fundo do poço.
